_meta.note: Fandom-wiki kit-text fallback for champions whose MCOCHUB page is thin (typically post-buff, before MCOCHUB catches up). The web app renders this alongside MCOCHUB's kit as a separate 'via Fandom' panel — same treatment as auntm.ai passives. Wiki-table tier scaling is replaced with a '[tier scaling table on Fandom]' marker and readers follow the source link for the numbers.

cards.title: Critical Hits
lines: 71% chance to boost Critical Rating by X for 7.5 seconds.
29% chance to inflict Weakness , reducing Attack by 35% for 6 seconds.
Dev Notes: With each critical hit, Spider-Man (Symbiote) will make your opponent weaker, while boosting his own attacks.

cards.title: Heavy Attacks
lines: 100% chance to inflict an Armor Break Debuff, removing 1 Armor Up Buff and reducing Armor Rating by X for 80 seconds.
Dev Notes: This Armor Break has a long duration and it’s important for Champions that depend on their Armor, like Killmonger or War Machine.

cards.title: Symbiotic Enhancement — Special Attacks
lines: The strange alien Symbiote grants Spider-Man enhanced Spider Senses whenever he activates a Special Attack, granting X % Evasion for 8 seconds.
Dev Notes: With his Signature Ability, Spider-Man (Symbiote) gains a chance to Evade any hits he would receive.

cards.title: Special 1 - Web-Slinger
lines: With unlimited web from the symbiote suit, there's plenty to go around.

cards.title: Special 2 - Swingin'
lines: Two feet in the face, courtesy of your friendly neighborhood Spider-Man.
This attack has 100% Critical Hit Chance.
Dev Notes: This is the Special Attack you want to use for the Critical Hit damage, especially after having Armor Breaks.

cards.title: Special 3 - Thwip, Thwip, Pow!
lines: The symbiote suit gives Spider-Man the strength to deliver more than just pizza.
